writeInt.claim: Encodes a signed native int before offering the complete ten-byte frame, retaining the previous padding, preserving partial writes on bounds faults and forwarding the writer error.
writeInt.limits: Legal buffer geometry with finite I/O. Reader returns bounded chunks and EOF or a fixed error at exhaustion. Writer records the offered alias and returns zero with nil or a fixed error. Also covers nil I/O interfaces and bounds panic classes. Arbitrary callback mutation or panic, concurrent access, and unbounded zero progress are outside scope.

All four native widths and alphabet profiles run on every row.
